description: Rank pages worth fixing: latest-run fails weighted by archived-month clicks. Returns the top 20 by default (raise limit to 100); total/hasMore say whether more exist. Empty means no evidence, not no problems. The weighting needs GSC clicks, so this ranking cannot be reproduced from the repo. Requires the audit:read scope.

limit.description: Max ranked pages to return (default 20, max 100)
